To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) a large scale benchmark dataset for event discovery from single image has been provided; (b) the dataset can be used for training and testing deep learning based approaches; (c) a deep learning based event discovery from single pictures approach is proposed.
we provide a large scale benchmark dataset of 490K images covering 14 types of social events.

we have created the largest event discovery from single image dataset, we have shown that deep learning based approach can be used for this problem and we have shown the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel approach for the discovery of social events from images.
the development of a large scale dataset for event discovery from single pictures.
the development of a large scale social event detection dataset and its application to event discovery from single pictures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed dataset is the first of its kind in terms of size and diversity, and it is intended to be the first step towards a more comprehensive and larger dataset that could be used as a common benchmark for future research in the event discovery domain.
this work presents the first large scale social event detection dataset, which is a significant step forward in the event discovery field.

the proposed dataset is a powerful benchmark for training, validation and comparison among different event discovery algorithms, which can help the multimedia community to advance in the research of event discovery from single pictures and, at the same time, can provide a useful tool for the development of applications for the social network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are providing a dataset for event discovery from single pictures, which is a very challenging task.
we provide the first large-scale benchmarking image dataset, called USED (Unsupervised Events Dataset), for the event discovery task.
we have provided a large-scale social dataset that can be used to train, validate, and benchmark the performance of event detection systems from single images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dataset is a large scale collection and it is properly annotated, which can be used as a benchmark for event discovery algorithms from a single image.

the proposed large scale dataset can be used to train and evaluate event discovery algorithms from a large variety of events, which can be used for many applications, including event detection, event classification, and social event discovery from a single image.
the proposed dataset can be a powerful support tool to train and test event discovery algorithms from still images.
